name: Warrior Kinship
label: Quest
description: Warrior Kinship: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are an adventurer, no doubt. I would ask an honorable task of you, but I must test your strength.
It is said that Rexxar would measure the sharpness of his blades by killing a helboar with a single, swift strike. Now I will measure your strength by killing them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The burning spines of the helboar leave horrific scars. Do not fear the pain and disfigurement, warrior, they are nothing compared to the prison to which I am bound.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I need no proof to know what you have done, adventurer. I can see the determination etched in your expression.
